publish.title: Publish this event?
publish.description: The event goes live and its details are locked. You can then send the invitations.

cancel.title: Cancel this event?
cancel.description: This is final: every issued ticket becomes invalid and no more answers are accepted.

locked.title: Read-only event
locked.description: A published or cancelled event can no longer change: your guests already have these details.

details.title: Details
details.description: What your guests see on their invitation and ticket.

settings.name: Event name
settings.descriptionHint: A few lines about the programme, dress code or access.
settings.timezoneHint: Guests always see times in this timezone.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.description: How your guests receive their invitation and ticket.
invitations.hint: At least one channel is required to publish.

rules.title: Ticket rules
rules.description: What your guests can do with their ticket.
rules.transferHint: A guest can pass their ticket to someone else.
rules.transferDeadlineHint: After this time, tickets can no longer be transferred.
rules.overbookingHint: Accept more confirmations than capacity, up to a limit.

quorum.title: Quorum
quorum.description: For general assemblies and statutory meetings: Jikū counts attendees live and timestamps the moment the quorum is reached. Leave “No quorum” for any other event.
quorum.alreadyReached: The quorum has already been reached. Changing the rule now does not change that time: it stands.
quorum.shareHint: The threshold rounds up: with 181 members, half requires 91 attendees.

tickets.title: Ticket categories
tickets.description: Split your guests into categories (VIP, press, standard), each with its colour, capacity and price. The ticket carries its category, and door staff see it when scanning. A paid ticket only gets in once paid, and your guests pay you directly.
tickets.emptyDescription: All your guests get the same free ticket. Add categories to separate access or set a price.
tickets.dialogDescription: The name and colour appear on the ticket and at the door.
tickets.label: Name
tickets.priceHint: Leave empty for a free category.
tickets.priceLocked: Tickets are already confirmed at this price: it can no longer change.
tickets.capacityHint: Optional. The event's own capacity also applies.
tickets.colorHint: Pick clearly different colours: door staff recognise them from afar.
tickets.confirmedUncapped: {count, plural, =0 {None confirmed} one {# confirmed} other {# confirmed}}, no cap

unavailable.title: Dashboard unavailable
unavailable.description: The event's figures could not be loaded. Try again.

doorLinks.title: Door links
doorLinks.description: One link per entrance, for the person checking guests in. Revoke it to cut access immediately.

bounces.description: About {percent}% of your recent emails bounced. Check the imported addresses: repeated bounces hurt delivery.

retention.description: Under the retention policy, guests' names, emails and phone numbers will be anonymized on {date}. Your attendance totals are kept.
